title: Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness
description:
Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.
 We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.
 Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.
 This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

title: Senior Manager, Mid-Market Sales (Signature Goods)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are looking for a Sales Manager to lead our Mid-Market Signature Goods team in San Francisco. Our Goods team is focused on growing advertisers across verticals such as CPG, Retail, and Pharma. We are looking for a strategic leader who will lead and grow this part of the business at scale.
 Reddit is a fast-growing platform with ambitious goals. In order to be successful, this person will need to be a self-starter who takes the initiative to uncover insights and opportunities that will uplevel our client partnerships and operational approach, ultimately positioning this team for long-term success. In addition to contributing to segment, team, and account-level strategy, you will also act as coach and mentor to a team of high-performing Client Partners, Client Account Managers and Client Account Executives.
 This role is required to work from our San Francisco office 1-2 days per week.
 Responsibilities:
 Manage a high-performing team of Client Partners, Client Account Managers, and Client Account Executives by recruiting and retaining top talent, while managing resources effectively
 Drive your team to exceed established revenue targets
 Advise sales and product management regarding market opportunities, sales positioning, use of resources, and strategic planning
 Partner with Marketing to drive new product launches, marketing communications, and further establish Reddit as a leader amongst challenger brands

title: Linux Engineer
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Linux Engineer An engineering role at Cloudflare provides an opportunity to address some big challenges, at scale. We believe that with our talented team, we can tackle some of the biggest security, reliability and performance problems facing the Internet.
 We are searching for Linux engineers to make our flavour of Linux fast, resilient and reliable across the many use cases that a distribution saving the Internet requires.

title: GTM Program Manager
description:
Role Description
 As a GTM Program Manager focused on the GTM organization, you will turn revenue-driving strategies into operational execution. You will play a crucial role in translating business priorities into the systems, processes, and business rules needed to bring new commercial initiatives to life and scale existing motions.
 You will lead cross-functional planning, define business requirements, align stakeholders, and drive delivery with business and technical partners. Your work will connect teams across the customer lifecycle, ensure operational readiness, and measure whether implemented solutions achieve their intended business outcomes.
 You will play a crucial part in helping the organization deliver on its growth strategy. You’ll build partnerships across GTM functions and see the direct impact of your work on revenue execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Responsibilities
 Translate strategy into execution: Turn revenue-driving strategies into actionable plans across GTM systems, processes, and business rules.
 Define business requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, document requirements, and establish clear success criteria.
 Lead cross-functional delivery: Manage programs from discovery through implementation, coordinating scope, timelines, dependencies, and accountable owners.
 Drive solution development: Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate options, resolve gaps, and implement scalable solutions.
 Align stakeholders and decisions: Facilitate discussions, clarify tradeoffs, and drive agreement on priorities, ownership, and outstanding decisions.
 Ensure operational readiness: Coordinate testing, documentation, and change management to support successful launches and adoption.
 Measure outcomes and improve: Track results against business objectives, identify operational gaps, and drive improvements to execution and the customer and seller experience.
